Class IsometricSprites

java.lang.Object
fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.sprite.IsometricSprites
public final class IsometricSprites extends Object
Provides predefined isometric sprites for terrain, objects, structures, walls, and stairs.

  • Method Details

    • registerWallCorner

      public static void registerWallCorner(Sprite corner, Sprite straightWall)
      Registers a family whose E/W PNG corners are assembled from straight walls. Additional wall families can register here without changing the renderer.
      Parameters:
      corner - corner value
      straightWall - straight wall value

    • cornerFaces

      public static List<IsometricSprites.CornerFace> cornerFaces(Sprite sprite, Orientation worldCorner)
      Corner artwork naming is opposite the actual tile side. N and S keep their single PNG; E becomes E then N (WEST then SOUTH in world axes), and W becomes S then W (NORTH then EAST in world axes). An empty list means that the original corner PNG must be used unchanged.
      Parameters:
      sprite - sprite to display
      worldCorner - world corner value
      Returns:
      the resulting value

    • isWallSprite

      public static boolean isWallSprite(Sprite sprite)
      Whether a sprite belongs to the wall atlas, not the column atlas.
      Parameters:
      sprite - sprite to display
      Returns:
      the resulting value
